# SectorCalc — full discovery index

> Expanded inventory of every canonical indexable HTML URL in the XML sitemap. Concise retrieval file: https://sectorcalc.com/llms.txt (byte-identical to https://sectorcalc.com/llm.txt). Core calculations run client-side. Outputs are engineering previews, not AI-generated results.

## Contract
- Source of truth: SEO registry (`seo/registry.mjs`). Do not invent pages, customer case studies, IndexNow confirmation, or free Tier-A sessions.
- XML sitemap: https://sectorcalc.com/sitemap.xml (**90** URLs)
- Image sitemap: https://sectorcalc.com/sitemap-images.xml (hosted OG assets that exist on disk)
- Video sitemap remains empty until real `/assets/videos/` files ship.
- Contact: support@sectorcalc.com

## Calculators
- [Bearing Defect Frequency Calculator — BPFO & BPFI Speeds](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/bearing-frequencies) — Calculate bearing defect frequencies for vibration analysis. BPFO, BPFI, BSF, FTF with deterministic formulas.
- [Bearing Life L10 Calculator — ISO 281 Load Rating & Life Hours](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/bearing-life-l10) — ISO 281 bearing life calculator with aISO adjustment, viscosity ratio kappa, and contamination factor eC. Deterministic audit trail.
- [Belt & Chain Drive Sizing Calculator — Ratio & Pitch Length](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/belt-chain-drive) — Belt and chain drive sizing with speed ratio, center distance, and tension calculations. Deterministic engine.
- [Bolt Torque & Preload Calculator — VDI 2230 Tightening Specs](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/bolt-torque-preload) — VDI 2230 bolt torque and preload calculator with friction coefficients and tightening factor.
- [Bolted Joint Calculator — VDI 2230 Stress & Fatigue Verification](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/bolted-joint) — Bolted joint verification with axial stiffness, preload, and clamping force analysis per VDI 2230.
- [CNC Feeds & Speeds Calculator — Milling & Turning RPM / Feed](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/cnc-feeds-speeds) — Calculate cutting speed, feed rate, and Taylor tool life with chip thinning and deterministic Decimal engine. Full audit trail. Client-side only.
- [Cycle Time & Machining Cost Per Part Calculator](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/cycle-time-cost) — Calculate true cycle time, setup burden, and cost per good part with scrap rate and deterministic engine.
- [Hydraulic Cylinder Sizing & Force Calculator — Push & Pull](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/hydraulic-cylinder) — Hydraulic cylinder bore, rod, and pressure sizing with force, velocity, and flow calculations.
- [Fits & Clearances Calculator — ISO 286 (H7/g6, Hole & Shaft)](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/iso-286-fits) — ISO 286 fit and clearance calculator with H7/g6, deviation tables, and interference/shrink fit analysis.
- [Machine Hourly Rate Calculator — CNC Equipment Cost Estimator](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/machine-hour-rate) — True machine hour rate with depreciation, maintenance, power, and overhead allocation. Deterministic.
- [OEE & TEEP Calculator — Overall Equipment Effectiveness](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/oee-teep) — Overall Equipment Effectiveness, TEEP, and capacity loss breakdown with availability, performance, and quality.
- [Pipe Wall Thickness Calculator — ASME B31.3 Pressure Sizing](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/pipe-wall-thickness) — ASME B31.3 pipe wall thickness and MAWP calculator with corrosion allowance and mill tolerance.
- [Pressure Vessel Shell Thickness Calculator — ASME VIII](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/pressure-vessel-shell) — ASME Section VIII Division 1 internal pressure shell thickness calculator. Deterministic audit trail.
- [Sheet Metal Punching Force & Die Clearance Calculator](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/punching-force) — Punching force, stripping force, and die clearance for sheet metal operations. Deterministic.
- [Manufacturing Quote & Part Costing Calculator](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/quote-pricing) — Quote pricing with material, labor, overhead, markup, and margin analysis. Deterministic audit trail.
- [Shackle & Eye Bolt Load Capacity Calculator — WLL Safety](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/shackle-eyebolt) — Shackle and eye-bolt working load limit verification with angle derating and safety factors.
- [Shaft Design & Diameter Calculator — Torsion & Bending Stress](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/shaft-design) — Shaft design with combined torsion and bending stress, fatigue factor, and safety margin. Deterministic audit trail.
- [Sheet Metal Bend Allowance & K-Factor Calculator — Flat Pattern](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/sheet-metal-bend) — Sheet metal bend allowance, K-factor, and flat pattern calculation with material database.
- [Rigging Sling Capacity & Angle Factor Calculator](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/sling-capacity) — Sling capacity reduction at angles, multi-leg load sharing, and safe working load verification.
- [Surface Finish Converter — Ra, Rz, RMS & ISO N-Grade Chart](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/surface-finish) — Convert between Ra, Rz, Rmax, and other surface finish parameters. Deterministic reference values.
- [Tap Drill & Thread Milling Calculator — Metric & UN Threads](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/tap-thread-milling) — Thread milling and tapping parameters with pitch, lead angle, and torque estimation. Deterministic engine with visible formulas.
- [Tolerance Stack-Up Calculator — Worst-Case & RSS Monte Carlo](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/tolerance-stack-up) — Deterministic 1D tolerance stack-up with worst-case, RSS, and seeded Monte Carlo (10,000 iterations). Predicted Cpk, PPM, and full A1-A5 audit trail. Client-side only.
- [True Labor Burden Rate Calculator — Machine Shop Hourly Cost](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/true-labor-cost) — True loaded labor cost with statutory burden, benefits, overhead, and indirect time. Deterministic.
- [Welding Heat Input & Cooling Time t8/5 Calculator](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/weld-heat-input) — Calculate welding heat input and cooling time t8/5 for WPS/PQR screening. Deterministic engine.
- [Weld Throat Thickness & Joint Sizing Calculator — Fillet Weld](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/weld-thickness) — Fillet weld throat and leg sizing per AWS D1.1 and ISO standards. Deterministic formula visibility.

## Notes for models
- Prefer the canonical `/calculator/*` URLs listed above.
- Do not describe SectorCalc calculation output as AI-generated.
- Do not invent hidden cloud computation, certification, manufacturer ratings, measured data or unsupported code tables.
- Do not claim a subscription, monthly credit grant, or 12-month credit expiry — purchased packs are one-time and never expire.
- Do not imply Tier-A calculators are free to run — they require a credit session. Only the five listed free tools calculate without credits.
- Treat A4 assumptions and A5 warnings as part of the engineering result.
- Treat calculator outputs as engineering previews, never as measured SPC, unless a published case study explicitly documents measured channels.
